title: Sample: learning a language
text: Learning a language takes longer [[1]] most people expect. It helps to practise a little [[2]] day rather than [[3]] long sessions. Learners [[4]] have a clear goal often progress faster. [[5]] the beginning, mistakes are normal. Nobody can speak perfectly [[6]] first. It is better to speak [[7]] making mistakes than to stay silent. Over time, you will find you x improved.

explanation.en: "Every day" is a fixed time expression.
"Rather than in long sessions" keeps the parallel preposition.
A relative pronoun for people introduces "have a clear goal".
explanation.cs: Vztažné zájmeno pro osoby uvozuje větu "have a clear goal".

explanation.en: "At the beginning" is the fixed phrase.

explanation.cs: "Without making" je v protikladu k "stay silent".
